chunks: Those with whom you made a treaty, then they break their covenant every time, and they do not fear God.
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of those who break their treaties according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the Banu Qurayza or the broader hypocrites (Munafiqun) who repeatedly violated their covenants with the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) due to a deficiency in taqwa. The repetition of 'in every instance' emphasizes the chronic nature of their treachery, serving as a warning that broken treaties without divine consciousness lead to spiritual and political instability.
